'''Overseers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2 if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4, with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 4 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by [[Heavy Bomber|Heavy Bombers]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Overseers are Flying Melee/Ranger/Summoner hybrids with a focus on rapid fire AoE projectiles.

*Their Melee Attack is performed by them swooping down towards their foes.
*Their Ranged Attack is performed by them rapidly shooting an explosive projectile in up to bursts of 6 that inflict [[Needler]].
*They are capable of summoning other Parasites, through the usage of Biomass projectiles, which create [[Biomass]] entities on contact with the ground or a target. The summoned Mobs will have the [[Rage]] Effect. The Biomass will be spawned by the Overseer shooting a specific projectile. Biomass particles will appear on the Overseer when this is being done.
**It will not do this attack if the target is above ground.
*Like all [[Pure Parasites]], Overseers can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them.
*Like all [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], Overseers can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport.
*Overseers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherOverseer.png}}

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Overseers are capable of spawning various [[Mobs]], through the usage of Biomass.

The summoning Ability is based on Points. Each Mob has a certain Points value.

'''Overseers have a total of 3 Points per summon and can summon 6 mobs before its cooldown of 10 seconds with a cap of 6 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Overseers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Overseers' head and part of their neck functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Overseers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

* Overseers are also known as '''Alafha''' in the Mod Files. 
* In 1.8.2, there was an insect-like Mob with the same name which was reworked into the Overseer.
